name: Said Bin Jashim
original_name: サイード・ビン・ジャーシム
source:
A prince of the kingdom of Aubia.
Because of the allowance of polygamy in the kingdom there are about 100 people in line to be the heir to the throne.
Said himself isn't interested in becoming king however and is against polygamy, he wants to love just one woman.
Ashe is a childhood friend of his, that he spent summer breaks with when he studied overseas in America.
His hobby is falconry.
translation:

His hobby is falconry.
